description: Disaggregates an outcome metric by one or more demographic groups and computes gap indices relative to a reference group (or the overall mean). Returns per-group mean, gap from reference, and equity index (group mean / reference mean). The most-requested IR analysis for accreditation and equity reporting.

metric_column.description: Numeric outcome to disaggregate (e.g. gpa, graduation_rate, completion_pct)

group_columns.description: Demographic columns to disaggregate by (e.g. pell_recipient, first_gen, ethnicity)

reference_group.description: Value in the first group column to use as the reference (e.g. 'non-Pell'). Defaults to overall mean if omitted.

min_group_size.description: Minimum number of records per group to include in the gap table (default 10)
